hello.text: A small man in a coat with too many pockets, sitting on a crate as if he's been there since the Steps were laid. "Quill. I buy things. Most folk on the quay ask where a thing came from. I find it rude."

choices.text: Things anyone else would ask about?

fence.text: "A merchant won't touch a purse that went missing on their own street. I'm not a merchant. Riverlands, Fields, up the Steps: I don't care whose it was. I care what it's worth."

again.text: "Back again. Nobody followed you, I hope."
